notes.content:
▼ Bug fixes

Fixed a bug that pause screen is not displayed during game play

notes.title: ver.1.5.0.0
notes.content:
▼ Update
・ Changed to display the game screen zoomed to the player
・ Change the volume of BGM / SE when starting the game for the first time
・ Adjusted increase in AT and MP gauges
・ Adjusted the power of automatic tracking bullets with the adjustment of AT gauge increase amount
・ Changed to be invincible when maximal magic attack
・ Changed so that some enemy attacks can be deleted by maximal magic attack
・ Worthless enemies respawn position adjustment.
・ Changed boss knockback behavior


▼ Bug fixes
・ Fixed a bug where pressing the X key on the quest selection screen does not return to the title
・ Correct the stage screen center area to be clear
・ Dragon stage replacement in Trial mode
・ Fixed a bug that the total rank displayed on the result screen is different.
・ Fixed a bug where the Smoke Effect of Skeleton King was not displayed
・ Fixed a bug that the screen does not shake due to enemy attacks when the game is over
・ Fixed a bug that automatic tracking bullets would remain when the game was over
Fixed a bug where Satan's attack would be swallowed to the stage when at the edge of the screen
